features.name: Script to talking-head video
features.description: Type a script, pick an agent and language, click Generate — the studio produces an MP4 of that portrait speaking the script.
features.notes: Full pipeline: TTS -> background -> face animation -> audio mux -> MP4 in outputs/

features.name: Choose your render engine
features.description: Pick how the face is animated per render: fast preview (LivePortrait) or production audio-driven quality (Hallo2).
features.notes: Engine dropdown; selection persisted to studio_config.json ui_prefs.render_engine

features.name: Lip-sync fix pass
features.description: Optionally run a post-process lip-sync pass on top of any render so the mouth matches the audio.
features.notes: video-retalking checkbox; WSL2 env + checkpoints in place; lip sync is the #1 open quality issue

features.name: Use a built-in agent or any photo
features.description: Render one of the QI agents (Tasuke, Maia, Naya, Kaze) or upload your own portrait photo.
features.notes: agents.json roster + custom_photo upload field; clear error if no photo found

features.name: Headless CLI render
features.description: Generate a Kokoro voice + Hallo2 avatar from the command line without opening the UI.
features.notes: run_avatar.bat <agent> "text" -> avatar_pipeline.py; --no-tts reuses an existing WAV

features.name: 10-language narration
features.description: Generate the voiceover in any of ten languages, each routed to the engine that sounds best for it.
features.notes: 6 local (Kokoro) + 4 Edge TTS; routing table in languages.json

features.name: Local, offline voices
features.description: American & British English, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, Italian and Mandarin run fully offline with no internet or API cost.
features.notes: Kokoro-82M (Apache 2.0) in the project .venv; kokoro==0.9.4

features.name: Microsoft neural voices
features.description: Japanese, French, Russian and German use free Microsoft Edge Neural voices where a good local voice isn't available.
features.notes: edge-tts==7.2.8; requires internet; used where Kokoro-82M lacks a usable voice

features.name: Voice catalog & overrides
features.description: Browse voices by category (Women / Men / Girls / Boys) and override the default voice for any language.
features.notes: VOICE_CATALOG with ~60 voice entries; per-language voice override carried through the pipeline

features.name: Speed & pitch control
features.description: Adjust how fast and how high or low the voice sounds per render.
features.notes: speed maps to Edge rate %; pitch via SSML for Edge, scipy resampling for Kokoro (+/-12 semitones)

features.name: Background replacement
features.description: Swap the portrait background for a solid color or an uploaded image before rendering.
features.notes: rembg==2.0.75 cutout + PIL composite; gracefully keeps original photo if rembg missing

features.name: Auto best-portrait finder
features.description: Point at a video and the studio samples frames and picks the sharpest, most front-facing, mouth-closed frame as the portrait.
features.notes: OpenCV Haar cascades score face area + eyes + Laplacian sharpness; ffmpeg frame extraction

features.name: Frame & screen capture
features.description: Grab a single frame from a video at a chosen timestamp, or screen-capture a region, to use as the source portrait.
features.notes: extract_frame_at() via ffmpeg; screen_capture_region() via PIL ImageGrab

features.name: Describe the avatar (Phase 2)
features.description: Generate an avatar from a text description instead of a photo.
features.notes: UI option present but records intent only; generation not implemented

features.name: One-click multi-language batch
features.description: Select several languages, enter a script for each, and render all of them in a single run with live per-language progress.
features.notes: pipeline_generate loops languages; per-language slug filenames + step counter

features.name: Scene movie pipeline
features.description: Split a long script into scenes, assign a character to each, render every scene, and concatenate them into one movie.
features.notes: scene_pipeline.py: manual (---), AI (NEXUS), or hybrid split; ffmpeg concat; AI split needs NEXUS reachable

features.name: Independent character roster
features.description: Use any photo and any name per scene, beyond the four built-in agents.
features.notes: characters.json supplemental roster + inline [Name:photo] syntax; surfaced in the Scene tab

features.name: D-ID cloud render
features.description: Render via the D-ID Talks API for a polished cloud result when local engines aren't enough.
features.notes: run_did() fully implemented (upload image+audio, create talk, poll, download); enabled in config but no API key set

features.name: HeyGen cloud render
features.description: Render via the HeyGen Talking Photo API as an alternative cloud provider.
features.notes: run_heygen() implemented; disabled in studio_config.json, needs API key

features.name: Secrets kept out of config
features.description: Cloud API keys load from a gitignored secrets file or environment at runtime and are never written back into the saved config.
features.notes: secrets/avatarstudio.env + _SECRET_MAP; save_studio_config strips keys before persisting

features.name: Kill & restart from the UI
features.description: Restart the studio with one button without touching the terminal.
features.notes: restart_studio() spawns a detached kill+relaunch helper; detached launcher start_studio.py also provided

features.name: Run as a Windows service
features.description: Install Avatar Studio as a QI_AvatarStudio Windows service so it survives reboots.
features.notes: install_service.bat registers NSSM QI_AvatarStudio (demand-start); not yet in QI_Service_Registry.md, no tunnel

features.name: QI Hive dashboard integration
features.description: Surface rendered avatars and studio status on the QI Hive Mission Control board.
features.notes: Listed in CLAUDE.md pending work; no integration wired (integrates_with empty in registry)
